replacements.old:
<COND (<NOT <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>> <RFALSE>)
	      (<EQUAL? ,PRSI ,RAILING> <RFALSE>)
	      (<NOT <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,LADDER ,WOODEN-DOOR ,SANDWICH-BAG ,TREE>>
	       <RFALSE>)
	      (<NOT <SHADOW-HELD? ,ROPE>>
	       <TELL "You would first need to be holding the rope." CR>)
	      (,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR
	       <TELL "One end of the rope is already committed to the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ". Untie it before inventing a second geometry." CR>)
replacements.new:
<COND (<NOT <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>> <RFALSE>)
	      (<EQUAL? ,PRSI ,RAILING> <RFALSE>)
	      (<NOT <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,LADDER ,WOODEN-DOOR ,SANDWICH-BAG ,TREE ,LIVING-CANYON-EDGE>>
	       <RFALSE>)
	      (<NOT <SHADOW-HELD? ,ROPE>>
	       <TELL "You would first need to be holding the rope." CR>)
	      (<AND <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,LIVING-CANYON-EDGE>
	            ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR
	            <NOT <EQUAL? ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ,SANDWICH-BAG>>>
	       <TELL "One end of the rope is already committed to the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ". Untie it before trying to prepare the canyon rim." CR>)
	      (<EQUAL? ,PRSI ,LIVING-CANYON-EDGE>
	       <V-LIVING-SECURE>)
	      (,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR
	       <TELL "One end of the rope is already committed to the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ". Untie it before inventing a second geometry." CR>)

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-UNTIE-ROPE ()
	<COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,CANYON-VIEW>
	            <IN? ,ROPE ,LIVING-CANYON-EDGE>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>
	            <OR <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,LIVING-CANYON-EDGE>
	                <AND <NOT ,PRSI> <NOT <UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED?>>>>>
	       <MOVE ,ROPE ,WINNER>
	       <COND (<UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED?>
	              <TELL "You free the upper knot from the canyon rim and recover the rope coil. The far end remains cinched to the brown sack." CR>)
	             (T
	              <TELL "You free the rope from the canyon rim and recover the coil." CR>)>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,CANYON-VIEW>
	            <IN? ,ROPE ,LIVING-CANYON-EDGE>
	            <UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED?>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>
	            <NOT ,PRSI>>
	       <TELL "Both ends are committed: the rope is cinched to the brown sack and secured at the canyon rim. Specify which knot you mean to undo." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<NOT ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR> <RFALSE>)
	      (<NOT <OR <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>
	                <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR>>>

replacements.old:
<TELL "The knot is around the brown sack at the far end of the line. You cannot untie that knot from here." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)>
	<TELL "You undo the knot around the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ". The rope is fully available again." CR>
	<SETG MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR <>>
replacements.new:
<TELL "The knot is around the brown sack at the far end of the line. You cannot untie that knot from here." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)>
	<COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ,SANDWICH-BAG>
	            <IN? ,ROPE ,LIVING-CANYON-EDGE>>
	       <TELL "You undo the knot around the brown sack. The cargo is free, but the rope remains physically secured at the canyon rim above." CR>
	       <SETG MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR <>>
	       <SETG MATERIAL-SACK-CINCHED <>>
	       <RTRUE>)>
	<TELL "You undo the knot around the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ". The rope is fully available again." CR>
	<SETG MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR <>>
